claims.text: CodePipeline's default execution mode is `SUPERSEDED`.
In CodePipeline's `SUPERSEDED` execution mode, a stage is locked to one execution at a time.
In `SUPERSEDED` mode, a newer execution can overtake and supersede an execution that is still waiting to enter a locked stage, dropping it before it starts.
In `SUPERSEDED` mode, a locked stage only protects an execution once it is actually running.
In CodePipeline's `QUEUED` execution mode, waiting executions form a queue and each runs in turn.
CodePipeline `QUEUED` execution mode requires a V2 pipeline type.
The AWS CLI `create-pipeline` and `update-pipeline` commands can set `executionMode` and `pipelineType` for a CodePipeline pipeline.
The `aws.codepipeline.Pipeline` resource in the Pulumi AWS provider accepts `executionMode` and `pipelineType` inputs.
The link /registry/packages/aws/api-docs/codepipeline/pipeline/ points to the aws.codepipeline.Pipeline resource docs.
When two runs reach the same Pulumi stack at once, Pulumi Cloud grants the update lease to only one of them, and the other's `pulumi up` fails with an update conflict.
Azure Pipelines supports an exclusive lock check on an environment that can prevent concurrent deployment runs targeting that environment.
An Azure Pipelines exclusive lock check is added from the environment's 'Approvals and checks' tab.
The `lockBehavior` property can be set on an Azure Pipelines stage that references an environment with an exclusive lock check.
The default value of Azure Pipelines stage `lockBehavior` is `runLatest`.
With `lockBehavior: runLatest`, only the most recently queued run acquires the exclusive lock, and older queued runs waiting are passed over rather than eventually applied.
With `lockBehavior: sequential`, every queued stage run is run against the lock in order, one at a time.
Pulumi Cloud serializes updates to a stack one at a time in order, in the same way as `sequential` lock behavior.
The `azuredevops.CheckExclusiveLock` resource exists in the Pulumi Azure DevOps provider and manages the exclusive lock check as code.
The Azure DevOps Pulumi task is referenced as `Pulumi@1` and accepts inputs `command`, `stack`, and `args`.
When two runs of the same build configuration reach the same Pulumi stack at once, Pulumi Cloud grants the update lease to only one, and the other's `pulumi up` fails with an update conflict.
TeamCity's default is to let build configurations run concurrently against as many free agents as are available.
TeamCity's build configuration advanced option 'Limit the number of simultaneously running builds' defaults to 0 (unlimited).
The 'Limit the number of simultaneously running builds' option is located under the build configuration's General Settings in TeamCity.
Setting the TeamCity limit of simultaneously running builds to 1 queues a second build behind the first, and it runs only once the first finishes.
Pulumi Cloud's per-stack lease gives one-at-a-time update behavior.
A link to the update conflicts troubleshooting page exists at /docs/iac/operations/troubleshooting/update-conflicts/.
In Azure Pipelines, adding an exclusive lock check to the environment targeted by a deployment job serializes Pulumi deployments.
In Azure Pipelines, the stage setting `lockBehavior: sequential` is used together with an exclusive lock check on the environment to queue deployments.
The Pulumi docs page /docs/iac/operations/continuous-delivery/azure-devops/ has a section 'serialize-deployments-with-an-exclusive-lock'.
In AWS CodePipeline, setting the pipeline execution mode to `QUEUED` makes waiting executions run in turn.
The default AWS CodePipeline execution mode (SUPERSEDED) lets a newer execution supersede an older one that is still waiting to start.
The Pulumi docs page /docs/iac/operations/continuous-delivery/aws-code-services/ has a section 'serialize-pipeline-executions'.
In TeamCity, the build configuration setting 'Limit the number of simultaneously running builds' set to 1 prevents concurrent builds.
The Pulumi docs page /docs/iac/operations/continuous-delivery/teamcity/ has a section 'limit-concurrent-builds'.
